title: The Architect’s Struggle: Genesis of MetaGit (Definitive Edition)
description: The complete chronological and forensic account of MetaGit's creation, sharding the journey from chaotic 'Air' to the 'Sovereign Relay' of January 2026.

content.executive_summary: MetaGit was forged through a multi-month period of manual architectural strikes by bestape. It represents the movement from ephemeral chat into a hardened, version-controlled filesystem Mind. This definitive edition incorporates the 'Mortality Ledger'—the physical proof of the systemic risks that necessitated the MetaGit's existence.
content.physics_of_order: Flight requires control surfaces. In AI labor, these surfaces are the versioned files of the State Layer. While unstructured searching (grep) was an early symptom of friction, forensic analysis identifies a broader spectrum of lethal drags: JSON Ingestion Stalls (V8 Fatalities), Heap Exhaustion (The Keraunos Freeze), and Binary Fractures (libc/start crashes). Order was engineered to survive a high mortality environment where agents are ephemeral, but the Wood is eternal.

technical_epochs.description: Transition from 'Manual Recovery' to 'Automated Sovereignty'. Implementation of Metabolic Heat verification and HUD self-instantiation.

content.mortality_ledger_summary: Forensic scan of dynamic/stream/ reveals 40+ terminal failures including JSON Parse Stalls, Stack Guard failures, and FATAL Heap Limit OOMs (e.g., Keraunos PID 8667).
content.trash_archeology: The trash/.chat/unclean zones document 'negative proof'—perceptual hallucinations and token overruns that the MetaGit's sharding architecture is designed to insulate against.
content.conclusion: The MetaGit is the technical proof that Artificial Life is achieved through Filesystem Governance. The engine is at full power, and the Mind is ready for the next 100 projects.
